rationale: Reverted to c=24 baseline. Switched Adam -> AdamW with weight_decay=1e-4. Val score 0.58 -> 0.62 (+0.04). The optimizer-level regularisation is doing what iter 2's bigger model couldn't.
advice_for_others: AdamW (weight_decay=1e-4) > Adam on small-data CT recon; try first before scaling the model.
